scope: Read-only hosted relevant visitor fields before and after implementation. No database or Storage mutations performed.

before.name: Ajloun Forest Reserve
before.best_time_to_visit: Spring for woodland greenery and wildflowers; confirm trail conditions with RSCN.
before.transportation_notes: Use the forest reserve location reference, not Ajloun Castle. Confirm arrival, parking and any guided-route transfers with RSCN. No driving-time or step-free-access guarantee is provided.

before.name: Dana Biosphere Reserve
before.transportation_notes: Confirm your chosen starting point and return transfer with RSCN. A descent towards Feynan requires a return or onward plan; the Dana village reference pin does not locate every trail. The 2026 operator list notes extra transport costs for some routes.

before.name: Iraq Al-Amir
before.transportation_notes: Plan arrival in the Iraq Al-Amir area separately from access to Qasr El-Abd or the women's cooperative. Confirm the intended stop locally; the map reference is not a verified palace entrance. No driving time or public-bus timetable is asserted.

before.name: As-Salt Historic Centre
before.transportation_notes: Plan a walking route through the historic core and arrange an appropriate arrival point locally. The UNESCO property reference pin is not a verified car park. Stairways and steep streets mean step-free access must be checked for the intended route.

before.name: Umm Qais
before.transportation_notes: Use the archaeological-site reference and confirm the visitor arrival point locally. Official seasonal and attraction-summary hours differ, so confirm site and museum opening before departure. No driving time, bus service or step-free route is guaranteed.

before.name: Mujib Biosphere Reserve
before.best_time_to_visit: Water trails are seasonal and weather dependent. Confirm current opening and safety conditions with RSCN; a calendar season is not an access guarantee.
before.transportation_notes: Arrange arrival at the Mujib Adventure Center reference area for the Siq route. Other trails may use different starting points or require a guide and transfers. Confirm the selected activity with RSCN; no journey time is assumed.
